title: Unified Data Repository Services; Stage 3 (UDR SBI)
tagline: UDR — policy data repository behind PCF decisions
summary: TS 29.504 defines the Nudr_DataRepository service on the UDR. In the 29.512 story, PCF reads session management and policy data from UDR while evaluating CreateSMPolicy — step 5 of PDU session establishment. UDR is the persistent store; 29.519 describes how consumers access that data.
defines: Nudr_DataRepository — policy and application data storage

Data repository resource model for 5GC policy
whyItMatters: SmPolicyDecision does not appear from nowhere — PCF loads rules and subscription policy from UDR. Without 29.504, step 5 (PCF evaluates policy) has no SBI contract for where policy data lives.
